au_f.name: AU Female
notes: DOL-X: pinned to exact model asset to avoid ambiguous release matching

Known issue: AU-F v0.9.3 still shows sidebar sprite layering/position error in DOL-X while upstream Lyra renders normally
Next diagnostic: test AU-F v0.9.3 with NeoUI disabled and BunnyTransformation absent; if still broken, isolate Mae's Picvary / NPC Avatars / BeautySelector interactions
